推近 1.34 且原点偏心，结尾侧栏与窗口上下边被切，主区下半是空白

changes: 第三级覆盖整个界面：工作区名、频道列表（选中态 #rebrand）、私信、频道头（话题 + 成员）与输入框都由灰条交叉显影成真内容，外围先一步、输入框收尾

issuesEn: Only the message rows became real; the sidebar and channel header stayed grey bars to the end, reading as unfinished loading
The 1.34 push with an off-center origin cropped the sidebar and the window's top/bottom edges, and the lower half of the main pane was empty
No exported duration; it relied on the md inference
The skeleton phase was static grey bars with no loading cue; avatars were grey squares and the font was hard-coded Helvetica
The window had a 2px grey border with a single shadow on a flat paper background
changesEn: The third level now covers the whole interface: workspace name, channel list (selected #rebrand), DMs, channel header (topic + members) and the composer all cross-develop from bars into content, periphery first and composer last
The push is now 1→1.22 about the window center so the whole window stays in frame; added SKELETON_REVEAL_DURATION = 172
One loading shimmer pass during the skeleton phase (lighten blend brightens only the bars); skeleton rows slide in with a strong ease-out

Avatars use four restrained gradients with inner highlight; system font stack, negative tracking and tabular timestamps; hairline window with three-layer soft shadow and floor shadow; soft-lit paper backdrop with grain
